resources.string: Voice typing uses your phone\'s speech service, normally Google\'s. While you speak, your voice is sent to Google to be turned into text. Nothing you type is ever sent. The next step asks for the microphone permission.
Microphone allowed. Hold the mic key and speak.

No speech service found on this phone. Install or enable Google\'s speech services.
